description: This is a Java source file containing unit tests for the AbstractSender class within the org.eclipse.hono.client.impl package. It verifies behaviors such as message sending, handling lack of credit, timeout scenarios, and message assertions.

classes.name: AbstractSenderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing various behaviors of AbstractSender, such as message sending with and without sufficient credit, timeout handling, and registration assertions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSendMessageRemovesRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Verifies that registration assertions are removed from messages when the peer does not support validation.

methods.name: testSendMessageFailsOnLackOfCredit
methods.description: Verifies that sending a message fails if there is no credit available.

methods.name: testSendMessageFailsOnTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that a message sending operation fails with a ServerErrorException if a timeout occurs.

methods.name: testCredits
methods.description: Checks that the getCredit() method returns correct credit values.

methods.description: Factory method to create instances of a subclass of AbstractSender with mocked behaviors for testing.
